about.title: Full-stack software engineer focused on production-ready systems.
body: I am a full-stack software engineer who develops enterprise solutions and end-to-end web and mobile applications. I work across the stack, building frontend experiences in React/Next.js, implementing backend services with NodeJS/Express and Rust (Axum), and designing the infrastructure that keeps systems reliable and secure.

I currently work as Lead Fullstack Software Engineer at Manuel S. Enverga University Foundation - Candelaria Inc. I also serve as a Lead Software Engineer on a part-time contractual basis at R-A-Ones Corporation in Canada, and lead a freelance group delivering software solutions for clients worldwide. I coordinate teams, own delivery, and translate product goals into pragmatic technical solutions.

Recently, I’ve been heavily invested in agentic AI workflows, developer harnesses, and autonomous coding tools—leveraging Claude Code, Antigravity (AGY), and Codex to accelerate software architecture and delivery.

Outside of software engineering, I am a passionate PS5 gamer (playing NBA 2K, Red Dead Redemption 2, and Cult of the Lamb) and a die-hard basketball fan who loyally follows LeBron James (the undisputed GOAT).

sports.allegiance: Loyal to LeBron James wherever he plays

steps.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
steps.caption: MSEUF-CI
steps.description: Leading the end-to-end development of internal enterprise systems, software infrastructures, and production observability platforms across university operations.
highlights: Architecting, implementing, and maintaining scalable full-stack web and mobile systems for university operations.

Architected and deployed image-based containerized environments (Docker) and engineered an end-to-end observability stack using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Alloy, Node Exporter, Dozzle, and Uptime Kuma for real-time telemetry, centralized logging, and infrastructure uptime monitoring.
Managing CI/CD deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and staging/production environments.
Overseeing system reliability, engineering standards, technical documentation, and best practices.

steps.title: Lead Software Engineer
steps.caption: R-A-Ones Corporation
steps.description: Leading end-to-end engineering for a startup, architecting core system designs, cloud infrastructure, backend services, and mobile applications.
highlights: Directing full-lifecycle development across high-throughput backend APIs, microservices, and cross-platform mobile apps.
Architecting distributed cloud infrastructure, containerized deployments, and database schemas for optimal performance.
Translating business and product requirements into clean, scalable system architecture and production roadmaps.

steps.title: Freelance Lead Developer
steps.caption: Ellipsense
steps.description: Leading a freelance team delivering full-stack web platforms and mobile applications for global clients.
highlights: Managing project roadmaps, client communications, technical scoping, and end-to-end delivery.
Designing resilient backend architectures and intuitive, responsive frontend interfaces tailored to client needs.
Enforcing code quality, testing standards, and seamless deployments across production systems.

steps.title: Web Developer
steps.caption: Techbears Solutions
steps.description: Developed the web administration and operational dashboard for a ride-hailing transportation platform.
highlights: Engineered the responsive administrative web dashboard using Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend paradigms.
Implemented granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) utilizing CASL for secure permission management across distinct user tiers.
Integrated real-time APIs for live dispatch management, operational monitoring, and fleet administration.

steps.title: Frontend Developer Intern
steps.caption: Linoflap Technology
steps.description: Contributed to the design and development of modern web applications using contemporary frontend technologies.
highlights: Collaborated with cross-functional engineering teams to implement responsive, pixel-perfect user interfaces.
Integrated RESTful APIs and assisted with backend service communication and state synchronization.
Participated in agile sprints, peer code reviews, and automated testing to maintain robust code standards.
